about: The server behind a project's File access setting: FTPS on the project's node, where people sign in with their own BuilderBot name and password. About 60 MB.
label: File access server (FTPS)
name: ftp

run:
dst="$2"; t="$(mktemp -d)"; mkdir -p "$dst/bin" "$dst/libexec"; tar -xzf "$1" -C "$t"; cp "$(find "$t" -name uv -type f | head -1)" "$dst/libexec/uv"; chmod +x "$dst/libexec/uv"; rm -rf "$dst/python" "$dst/venv"; export UV_PYTHON_INSTALL_DIR="$dst/python" UV_CACHE_DIR="$t/cache" UV_NO_CONFIG=1; "$dst/libexec/uv" venv -q --python 3.12 "$dst/venv"; "$dst/libexec/uv" pip install -q --python "$dst/venv/bin/python" pyftpdlib pyopenssl; test -f "${BB_LIB:-}/bbftp.py" || { echo "bbftp.py is not beside bb: install this from bb toolchains" >&2; exit 1; }; cp "$BB_LIB/bbftp.py" "$dst/libexec/bbftp.py"; printf '#!/bin/sh
here="$(dirname "$(readlink -f "$0")")"
exec "$here/../venv/bin/python" "$here/../libexec/bbftp.py" "$@"
' > "$dst/bin/bb-ftpd"; chmod +x "$dst/bin/bb-ftpd"; rm -rf "$t"
